method: Manual review of test bodies against original stimuli. Review alone is not execution evidence. Existing e388227 mappings are retained only for unchanged tests; corrected or extended stimuli are replaced below.

requirements.rationale: Pause dispatch, commit an authorized command or canonical delivery, revoke grant or sender permission, resume and observe REJECTED with zero native writes.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic peers; authorization and durable dispatch are the production composition.

requirements.rationale: Count and byte exhaustion return explicit QUOTA_EXCEEDED before partial canonical effects. Concurrent producers cannot exceed the final slot, managed claims/grants roll back, accepted unread delivery is not discarded, and explicit safe cancellation restores capacity.
requirements.limitations: Disposable store and synthetic peers; not a throughput or sustained flood measurement.

requirements.rationale: Payload and manifest fsync precede catalog reference. Failed fsync creates no reference; failure after publication writes rolls back catalog while retaining reusable durable bytes. Authorized cleanup collects unpublished bytes, preserves unrelated files and never repeats native inference.
requirements.limitations: Injected storage/commit faults on disposable filesystem; directory-fsync guarantees remain platform-specific as documented in backup/restore.

requirements.rationale: Current permissions, pending/rejected approval and active guardrail each prevent publication while retaining private durable output. Caller cannot decide operator approval and the rejection notification does not become another native turn.
requirements.limitations: Owned protocol peer with actual canonical policy and publication services; not a real-model behavior assertion.

requirements.rationale: Migration 057 trigger creation rolls back at an injected SQL failure, then reexecutes once; historical 028/029 upgrade preserves agent data and repeated runner is empty.
requirements.limitations: The requirement also calls for an interrupted nonempty data backfill with historical event/binding counts. Trigger creation on an empty fixture is not that stimulus.

requirements.rationale: Conflicting legacy role is rejected before factory invocation; JSON-string metadata becomes session metadata while canonical profile metadata remains unchanged.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic external peer; this is facade/identity normalization, not native protocol qualification.

requirements.rationale: A scoped grant enables read/send on its endpoint over REST and MCP, exhausts its execution budget, denies adjacent actions/listing, requires explicit binding for open, and returns identical opaque errors for foreign and missing resources.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic peers in the production HTTP/MCP composition. Work-specific grants have separate T-WORK requirements.

requirements.rationale: Caller without authority cannot reuse an operator's completed open key to obtain the persisted reply.
requirements.limitations: Other persisted operation/control/result surfaces need matching authorization-before-idempotency assertions.

requirements.rationale: Opens two approved endpoints for one canonical identity, sends one canonical message and verifies exactly one native send at the selected higher-priority endpoint.
requirements.limitations: Production selection/dispatch with synthetic native peers.

requirements.rationale: Two equally eligible endpoints return AMBIGUOUS_BINDING without constructing a connector; explicit endpoint selection succeeds.
requirements.limitations: Production open selection with synthetic native peers.

requirements.rationale: Pending committed delivery is recovered by a replacement dispatcher and retains exactly one inbox row.
requirements.limitations: Dispatcher replacement in one process is not the specified process kill after commit and before wake.

requirements.rationale: Thread-local transaction instrumentation covers native send and journal fsync; artifact storage proves independent SQLite writes can proceed.
requirements.limitations: Aggregate requirement additionally instruments spawn, network, secret resolvers and model paths.

requirements.rationale: Already-open legacy SQLite writers are rejected after activation; actual feature-OFF stdio writer cannot commit an unreserved delivery; a compatible stdio writer remains usable; future contract cannot be downgraded by owner startup.
requirements.limitations: Writer compatibility is a store integrity fence, not protection against an arbitrary database administrator.

requirements.rationale: Preserves 1000 wakes and the snapshot-to-wait race; production scan is held while a message commits, then dispatch proceeds before a one-hour recovery timer.
requirements.limitations: Deterministic event barriers exercise the race; elapsed time is a bounded assertion, not a throughput benchmark.

requirements.rationale: Actual authenticated stdio process creates a canonical intent against the HTTP owner's store; owner identity is unchanged and the owner's peer receives the write. Stdio open succeeds through owner proxy with an absent child-local executable.
requirements.limitations: External harness peers are synthetic; the Nexus producer is a separate real process.

requirements.rationale: A slow lane with backlog cannot hide a healthy lane. Additional endpoints do not multiply an agent's normal worker budget. A real owned protocol-peer terminal cannot free the still-blocked transport stack's slot, while another agent progresses.
requirements.limitations: Matches this row's slow-endpoint/backlog/per-agent stimulus. Repeated flood, delayed startup and crash-pressure sampling remain separately required by T-E2E-04 and P12; this row does not certify them.

requirements.rationale: Projection repository failure retains terminal bytes and recovers one result after restoration. An owned protocol peer emits 256 deltas plus terminal while projection is locked; durable journal advances and full output projects after release.
requirements.limitations: Injected projection failure/block and real local protocol process, not a real provider or physical disk-loss campaign.

requirements.rationale: Appends incomplete frame bytes to a closed journal; reopening reports one tail repair and preserves exactly the complete record.
requirements.limitations: Deterministic file fault injection rather than power-loss hardware testing.

requirements.rationale: Flips a byte inside a complete journal frame after close, verifies checksum failure at restart and rejects further appends as unavailable.
requirements.limitations: Deterministic file fault injection.

requirements.rationale: All 256 native delta characters and final native text survive journal capture under blocked projection and appear in the durable correlated result after release.
requirements.limitations: Owned Codex-shaped Python protocol peer, not a real model.

requirements.rationale: Append between replay pages preserves sequence without gaps; invalid limits/cursors rejected, and foreign authenticated caller cannot read event history.
requirements.limitations: Expired/retained cursor behavior across retention needs explicit mapping; no claim that native replay is available.

requirements.rationale: Both REST and MCP open/close/reopen; all Agent dataclass fields are snapshotted after each transition, including explicit role/capabilities/metadata/tags/permissions/comm_scope. New session on reopen, no canonical mutation.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic peers; production identity/open/presence composition.

requirements.rationale: Unknown identity rejected through REST and MCP, nonempty canonical error, no factory invocation, no Agent/session inserted, existing profile unchanged.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic peer factory observes no invocation.

requirements.rationale: Concurrent distinct endpoints and same request key for one Agent; expected peer/session counts, repeat through MCP resolves identical session, canonical presence/Agent assertions.
requirements.limitations: An in-progress identical request may return transient CONFLICT; subsequent retry resolves its original result. Synthetic peers.

requirements.rationale: Approved opaque env reference echoed by owned process is removed before raw journal, durable result, replay and logs, including split/character fragments and two turns; constructor/start errors and allow/deny approval projections are scrubbed while diagnostic policy remains trustworthy.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic known credential only, no personal secret files; no universal detection of encoded exfiltration. Historical e388227 FAIL retained separately and not relabeled.

requirements.rationale: Three concurrent candidates across two Agents and three endpoints produce one claimant, outbox binding, charged grant and native send.
requirements.limitations: Loser responses and offer projections are not inspected for restricted payload; privacy portion of aggregate requirement still needs explicit evidence.

requirements.rationale: Handoff offer creates no executable outbox fan-out. Claim creates exactly one binding/native delivery; repeated claim reuses operation and charges the grant once. Native turn end leaves canonical work claimed until explicit completion.
requirements.limitations: Production app with synthetic external peers; not simultaneous approved native providers.

requirements.rationale: Actual connector receives authoritative identity/role/skills/workspace/profile and delivery intent without secret refs or key hashes; identity remains intact. Versioned explicitly admitted result contract performs completion and rejects forged authority.
requirements.limitations: Authenticated child MCP tool access is not fabricated; completion uses the implemented scoped structured-result contract. Synthetic native peer.

requirements.rationale: Correlated terminal/result and structured-looking text without explicit structured completion admission both leave the handoff CLAIMED. Only canonical authorized complete transitions it.
requirements.limitations: Owned synthetic process; native campaign separately tests this contract.

requirements.rationale: Authorized evidence completes/rejects through core, verification-required work stays VERIFYING, claimant cannot self-verify or impersonate creator, stale generation is fenced and authorized reviewer completes the current generation via REST.
requirements.limitations: Canonical HTTP/MCP and synthetic result peer; reviewer decision is test operator input.

requirements.rationale: Operator explicit risk-acknowledged recovery reopens uncertain old work; new claim increments epoch. Late old terminal is durably retained under its old operation while structured completion is BLOCKED and new work remains CLAIMED.
requirements.limitations: Controlled old native event is injected at production ingress; real provider replay is not assumed.

requirements.rationale: Interrupt can bypass blocked normal write and remains SENT_UNCONFIRMED with the exact target operation, not terminal success.
requirements.limitations: Need exact managed-work delayed terminal/canonical interrupt-requested projection evidence; an interrupt write return alone is not acceptance.

requirements.rationale: Codex shell/file and Claude Write requests pass through canonical durable HITL, caller cannot decide, both operator allow/deny map to exact native replies; Claude cannot update permissions or turn unsupported policy requests into authorization.
requirements.limitations: Fixture allow/deny covers protocol contract. Real approved native denial campaigns are separate. Pi/attach do not gain unsupported approval capability.

requirements.rationale: Duplicate decision reuses canonical result, conflicting decision is denied, uncertain write is never repeated. Late/cancelled/ended requests become NOT_SENT and consumed native request ID cannot be reused by next turn.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic peers; no native deduplication or delivery ACK is invented.

requirements.rationale: Unsupported native requirement is rejected before spawn; disabling required HITL fences managed claim without grant charge and retains incoming logical inbox delivery.
requirements.limitations: Need jointly mapped compatible conversational endpoint and unsupported sandbox requirement assertions to complete the exact aggregate stimulus.

requirements.rationale: Restart production lifespan with stable boot specs; repeated boot reuses session/request, identity preserved. Failed connector isolated, remaining endpoint ready; uncertain failed start stays quarantined on restart.
requirements.limitations: Disposable production bootstrap and synthetic peers; native processes qualified separately.

requirements.rationale: Actual serve SIGTERM reaps owned child; shared shutdown keeps owner and journal capture while delayed close runs, rejects late work, finishes after drain.
requirements.limitations: Actual serve signal case opens live session but does not stage active turn plus pending journal. Joint crash/turn/projection stimulus still required; Windows SIGTERM is platform-skipped.

requirements.rationale: Concurrent closes overlap final native event and EOF; same durable close operation, one connector close, one captured final, closing entry released. Projection failure/repeated close recovery is separately exercised.
requirements.limitations: Controlled peer EOF, no native model. Error and EOF use the shared cleanup path.

requirements.rationale: Production factories reuse exact native connection for two endpoints, one detach preserves process and sibling durable result, last close observes stop. Active-close terminal correlation and stale-terminal uncertainty tested.
requirements.limitations: Owned Codex protocol peer. Real Codex multiplex also passed separately at752cd72, not counted in this full-suite manifest.

requirements.rationale: Three managed adapters reject oversized unbroken stdout; bounded Unicode/stderr chunks; production framing failure and subscription overflow captured with explicit uncertainty and owned-process cleanup.
requirements.limitations: Need explicit combined fragmented-byte UTF-8 and saturated stdout/stderr pipe-pressure assertion mapping; component StringIO test is not real pipe backpressure.

requirements.rationale: Malformed/unsupported Pi readiness fails with protocol_incompatible diagnostic and quarantines binding while Codex can still open; invalid Codex native thread identity never becomes ready or receives turn/start.
requirements.limitations: Synthetic incompatible protocol peers; native binary version qualification is separately controlled.
